summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers such as _0x488df8, string-indirection objects wrapping literals like 'ldd', '--version', '/etc/os-release', 'musl', 'Alpine') and, on npm install, selects an OS/arch-specific Bun release, downloads it from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, chmod +x's the extracted bun binary, and execFileSync's it against a sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header, WV8StW string-array rotator, ~2000-entry symbol-indirection table n7gIxM) shipped in the tarball but not referenced by the declared module entry (lib/component.js) and not covered by the package.json files whitelist ('files': ['lib/*']). The advertised purpose is a Vue alert-input component, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated second bundle. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute a payload that a Node-based scanner cannot follow, and the payload is only reachable when invoked by that alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
